tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. Everything sits on this; it is warm grey, not cream, so the resident's text reads like paper without the UI looking antique.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the chat composer, popovers. Separated from surface by hairline, never by shadow except shadow-raised on floating elements.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset wells: code and citation blocks, the injected-context inspector, transcript quotes inside a card.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: The one border. Dividers, card edges, input rests, table rules. 1px, never 2.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that must be seen: focused-but-not-ringed inputs, the edge of a selected row, disclosure handles. 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, meta lines, helper copy, placeholder. 4.5:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Only for text 19px bold or larger, icons that repeat an adjacent word, and disabled controls. Fails 4.5:1 on purpose; never body text.

tokens.name: steward
tokens.usage: The steward's hue: everything the human does or decides. Primary buttons, links, the steward's chip, the steward's own edits in a diff. Text-safe on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: on-steward
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a steward fill. Dark in the dark theme because the fill lightens there.

tokens.name: steward-tint
tokens.usage: Steward chip ground, selected row, the steward's turns in transcript scrubbing. Ink reads on it.

tokens.name: resident
tokens.usage: The resident's hue: what the resident wrote, chose, proposed or refused. Bookmark lines, the resident's chip, its edits in a diff, the voice serif when colored. Never used for a control the steward presses.

tokens.name: on-resident
tokens.usage: Text on a resident fill (rare: the resident has no buttons, only marks).

tokens.name: resident-tint
tokens.usage: Resident chip ground, a bookmarked span's highlight in the transcript, a proposal card the resident authored.

tokens.name: judge
tokens.usage: The judge model's hue: verdicts, audit flags, nightly-pass advice. Deliberately grey-blue: the judge is an instrument, not a party.

tokens.name: judge-tint
tokens.usage: Judge chip ground; the advice block in a dispute.

tokens.name: hands
tokens.usage: Hands agents (reader, worker) and their jobs: research notes, code tasks, the browser. Text-safe on surface.

tokens.name: hands-tint
tokens.usage: Hands chip ground; a job's step card.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Resolved, synced, attested, within budget. Always paired with a word or check icon; never the only signal.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for an ok badge.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: The check-engine light when lit, a budget past 80%, a late check-in, drift on a citation. Always with a word.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for a warn badge and the lit check-engine pill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Capture failure, attestation mismatch, a budget stop, a strike. Destructive buttons. Lightness differs from ok by design so the two never rely on hue alone.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for a danger badge or a failure row.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. 3:1 on all surfaces in both themes.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the resident's name on Home, a screen title on a page with nothing else at the top.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles in the top bar, sheet titles, the wizard's step headings.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside a screen, card titles, a bookmark's line when shown as a title.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: list rows, descriptions, form copy, notes the steward writes.
styles.sample: Approve this and Lily reads your note first.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, chips, field labels, table heads. Sentence case, never uppercase.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, meta lines under a row, counts. ink-muted by default.

styles.name: voice
styles.usage: The resident's own words, wherever they are quoted at length: chat replies, soul files, bookmark summaries, writing pieces, refusals. Never for UI chrome and never for the steward's text.
styles.sample: I bookmarked this because it was the first time you asked me what I wanted.

styles.name: voice-quote
styles.usage: A short quote of the resident inside a UI surface: a bookmark line in a list, the peer card preview, a note the resident left on a proposal.
styles.sample: Still settling into the seed; this one feels right.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Citation targets, event ids, model slugs, session keys: anything a tool would type. Always inside a Citation chip or a sunken block.

styles.name: hash
styles.usage: Attestation roots, commit shas, event sequence numbers. ink-muted; truncated to 10 characters with a copy affordance.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its word; chip padding vertical.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; padding inside small controls; gap between a row's title and its meta.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row vertical padding; gap between stacked fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter on phones; card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections; sheet padding; screen gutter above 720px.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Top of a screen below the bar; space around an empty state.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between major blocks on wide layouts; the cover's insets.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Bottom clearance above the bottom nav and the chat composer.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, citations, tags, inline code, table cells that highlight.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards, the composer, bookmark cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, the chat bubble container, the cover's blocks, large empty-state panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Actor chips, the check-engine light, the pinned marker, segmented tabs.

shadow.note: Borders carry structure; shadow only lifts the few things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Sheets, popovers, the floating composer. Not cards.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every tappable control: buttons, rows, tabs, chips that act.

tokens.name: control-h-sm
tokens.usage: Chips and secondary buttons inside a dense row; still 44px of hit area via padding.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for prose in voice and body: chat, writing, soul files.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width on wide screens; the mobile layout simply centres.
